scope: Segment 113 field-level rules, serialization, applicability, and companion-segment scope for the dedicated ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Request
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 12730-12830 (Section 12.12), lines 8236-8330 (Section 11.3), lines 7528-7610 (Section 11.1.1 Financial Transaction Request companion list, confirms 113 absent), lines 20805-20845 (Element 63 processing rules), lines 23007-23108 (Elements 131-137), lines 5900-6045 (Section 10.8 Check Processing Requirements)

rules.title: Segment 113 belongs exclusively to the ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
rules.note: REOPENED 2026-09-29 (SEG113-SME-009): the Chapter 12 segment/transaction matrix (read from the PDF layout) marks Segment 113 in the Financial Transaction Request column as well as the ECA/TeleCheck column, identically to Segment 110, and Section 12.12 says Segment 113 'can appear in any of the fields in Data Section No. 3' with a pointer to Section 11.1. Only the Section 11.1.1 layout table omits it (it also omits Segment 110, which the SME approved for Financial requests on 2026-09-26). Previously confirmed exclusive on 2026-09-22. Held at REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.title: Segment 113 is a conditional member of the ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Request's Data Section 3 (present when check-service risk-control data is being sent)
rules.note: SME-resolved 2026-09-22 (SEG113-SME-001): Section 11.3.1's layout table governs over Element 63's incomplete processing-rule summary, which omits Segment 113 from its ECA/TeleCheck request segment list. SEPARATE SME-resolved discrepancy (SEG113-SME-007): Section 11.3.1's own field table marks Segment 113 'R' (Required) while its narrative intro says 'none, one, or more'; user confirmed 2026-09-22 to keep Segment 113 CONDITIONAL, populated specifically when Card Type = 046 (ECA/TeleCheck), not required for every check-processing Card Type (041/045/046).

rules.title: Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Segment 113 maximum length is 156 alphanumeric characters
Field order matches Section 12.12 ascending element order (85, 84, 131, 132, 133, 134, 135, 136, 137)
rules.note: Unlike Segment 108, Segment 113 has no field-order reversal quirk; fields 3-9 map directly to elements 131-137 in ascending order.

rules.title: All fields are separated by Field Separators; empty fields still send the separator
ECA/TeleCheck® Clerk ID, required, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6
ECA/TeleCheck® Product Code, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6 and has no documented enumeration (free-form, merchant/risk-control defined)
rules.note: SME-confirmed 2026-09-22 (SEG113-SME-002): no external code table exists for this element; validate type/length only.

rules.title: ECA/TeleCheck® Phone Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
ECA/TeleCheck® Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 22; required on Void transaction requests
rules.note: SME-confirmed 2026-09-22 (SEG113-SME-003): the Void-requires-Trace-ID business condition is cataloged only, not code-enforced by the JSON payload validator (same treatment as similar business-condition rules in Segments 103/108).

rules.title: Merchant Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 25
Denial Record Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 7; used to reference a declined ECA/TeleCheck® transaction on Denial Record receipts
Extended MICR Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 65; must supplement MICR Data (Element 122) in Segment 110 when raw MICR data exceeds 50 bytes
rules.note: SME-confirmed 2026-09-22 (SEG113-SME-004): this cross-segment (110<->113) dependency is cataloged only, not code-enforced by the single-segment JSON payload validator.

rules.title: Segment 113 appears at most once per message

Segment 113's ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Request Data Section 3 siblings are Segment 110 (Check Data Segment, Field No. 4, required) and Segment 111 (Variable Information Data Segment, Field No. 5, required per the Section 11.3.1 layout table)
rules.note: Aligned 2026-09-29 with SEG110-R-001 and the Section 11.3.1 layout table, which marks Segment 111 'R' in Field No. 5. The previous 'optional' wording had no SME reference. Held at REVIEW_REQUIRED pending P-08, because Section 11.3.1's narrative intro says Data Section 3 contains 'none, one, or more' of Segments 110/111/113.

rules.title: Segment 113 does not appear in the ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Response, which mirrors the generic Financial Transaction Response layout
